meta.source: UESP wiki (en.uesp.net), MediaWiki API snapshot under research/sources/uesp/
meta.attribution: Text from the Unofficial Elder Scrolls Pages (UESP), https://en.uesp.net/ ; each record names its page and revision id.
notes: One record per distinct shout. Skyrim shout pages are the primary source for the words, their rune spelling and their meanings; other pages that name the same words are listed under also_attested_in, with differs_from_primary set where their English differs.
word = first letter upper case, rest lower case (as the wiki's infobox renders it); word_wiki_spelling = the infobox parameter as typed, in rune-case.
ESO rows come from the table on Online:Dragon; their 'name' is the ESO ability the wiki pairs with the line, where it gives one.
lore_thuum_list repeats the whole 'Known Shouts' list of Lore:Thu'um, including shouts for which the wiki records no dragon words.

shouts.name: Animal Allegiance

words.effect: Animal Allegiance for 30 seconds in 75 ft
Animal Allegiance for 45 seconds in 150 ft
Animal Allegiance for 60 seconds in 250 ft
words.location: Ysgramor's Tomb (atop the hill, quest locked)

shouts.in_game_description: A Shout for help from the beasts of the wild, who come to fight in your defense.
locations: Ysgramor's Tomb (atop the hill, quest locked)
shouts.wiki_summary: Animal Allegiance is a dragon shout that causes nearby animals to fight for you.

also_attested_in.note: Raan Mir Tah, meaning Animal Allegiance Pack, is a shout that can call for the beasts of the wilderness to aid the Tongue in combat.

shouts.name: Aura Whisper
shouts.in_game_description: Your Voice is not a Shout, but a whisper, revealing the life forces of any and all.
shouts.wiki_summary: Aura Whisper is a dragon shout that reveals nearby mobile entities, similar to the Detect Life spell effect. Aura Whisper will reveal both NPCs and creatures.

also_attested_in.note: Laas Yah Nir, meaning Life Seek Hunt, is a shout that reveals the life force of any and all beings nearby.

shouts.name: Battle Fury

words.effect: Battle Fury, 1.3 points within 25 feet for 60 seconds
words.location: All three words are found in Vahlok's Tomb

words.effect: Battle Fury, 1.5 points within 25 feet for 120 seconds
Battle Fury, 1.7 points within 25 feet for 180 seconds

shouts.in_game_description: Your Thu'um enchants your nearby allies' weapons, allowing them to attack faster.
locations: All three words are found in Vahlok's Tomb
shouts.wiki_summary: Battle Fury is a dragon shout added by the Dragonborn expansion that improves the fighting ability of allies by speeding up their attacks, similar to the Elemental Fury shout's effect on you.

also_attested_in.note: Mid Vur Shaan, meaning Loyal Valor Inspire, is a shout that allows the allies of the Tongue to fight faster and with more fury.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Online:Dragon, table of shouts spoken by generic dragons in ESO
also_attested_in.note: Corresponding ability: Battle Fury (On Atronach Minions)

shouts.name: Become Ethereal
shouts.in_game_description: The Thu'um reaches out to the Void, changing your form to one that cannot harm, or be harmed.
shouts.wiki_summary: Become Ethereal is a dragon shout that turns you into an ethereal form. While in this form, you cannot deal damage or take damage (including damage from falls or poison).

also_attested_in.note: Feim Zii Gron, meaning Fade Spirit Bind, is a shout that turns the Tongue into an intangible ghost-like form, unable to be harmed.

shouts.name: Bend Will

words.effect: Forces NPCs and creatures to become allies for 30 seconds
words.location: Taught to you by Hermaeus Mora (during The Gardener of Men)

words.effect: Tames dragons and allows them to be ridden
words.location: Taught to you by Hermaeus Mora (during The Gardener of Men)

shouts.in_game_description: Your voice bends the very stones to your will. As it gains power, animals, people, and even dragons must do your bidding.
locations: Taught to you by Hermaeus Mora (during The Gardener of Men)
Taught to you by Hermaeus Mora (during The Gardener of Men)
shouts.wiki_summary: Bend Will is a dragon shout obtained by progressing through the Dragonborn expansion's main questline. After learning and unlocking the first word, you are able to cleanse the All-Maker Stones located throughout the island by shouting at them.

also_attested_in.note: Gol Hah Dov, meaning Earth Mind Dragon, allows the Tongue to bend and control the will of others, even dragons.

shouts.name: Call Dragon

words.location: High Hrothgar or Sky Haven Temple (all words learned together during The Fallen)

shouts.in_game_description: Odahviing! Hear my Voice and come forth. I summon you in my time of need.
locations: High Hrothgar or Sky Haven Temple (all words learned together during The Fallen)
shouts.wiki_summary: Call Dragon is a dragon shout that summons Odahviing to fight alongside you, but only if it is used outdoors. After shouting all three words, there will be a short delay, then Odahviing will arrive at your location.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Skyrim Very Special Edition, 'Shout Progression' table

shouts.name: Call of Valor

words.location: Sovngarde (all words learned together during Dragonslayer)

words.effect: Summons Felldir the Old for 60 seconds.

shouts.in_game_description: The valiant of Sovngarde hear your Voice, and journey beyond space and time to lend aid.
locations: Sovngarde (all words learned together during Dragonslayer)
shouts.wiki_summary: Call of Valor is a dragon shout that summons a hero to fight alongside you. Tsun teaches this shout to you at the end of Dragonslayer, the conclusion of the main quest.

also_attested_in.note: Hun Kaal Zoor, meaning Hero Champion Legend, is a shout that can summon the ghost of a hero from Sovngarde to aid the Tongue in battle.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Skyrim Very Special Edition, 'Shout Progression' table

shouts.name: Clear Skies

words.location: High Hrothgar (during The Throat of the World)

shouts.in_game_description: Skyrim itself yields before the Thu'um, as you clear away fog and inclement weather.
locations: High Hrothgar (during The Throat of the World)
shouts.wiki_summary: Clear Skies is a dragon shout that clears weather effects. All three words of this shout are learned from the Greybeards during The Throat of the World as part of the main quest.

also_attested_in.note: Lok Vah Koor, meaning Sky Spring Summer, is a shout that can dispel storms and clouds, and even magical mists.

shouts.name: Cyclone

words.effect: Small cyclone, inflicts 50 damage, tosses enemies and objects into the air.
Medium cyclone, inflicts 75 damage, increased area of effect and range.
Large cyclone, inflicts 100 damage, further increased area of effect and range.

shouts.in_game_description: Your Thu'um creates a whirling cyclone that sows chaos among your enemies.
shouts.wiki_summary: Cyclone is a dragon shout added by the Dragonborn expansion. When used, the shout fires out a small cyclone that throws enemies, even large enemies like giants, into the air causing moderate damage.

also_attested_in.note: Ven Gaar Nos, meaning Wind Unleash Strike, is a shout that can summon a whirling tornado.

shouts.name: Disarm
shouts.in_game_description: Shout defies steel, as you rip the weapon from an opponent's grasp.
shouts.wiki_summary: Disarm is a shout that pulls the weapon out of an opponent's grasp. It is one of the more common shouts used by draugr, which can be quite an issue if you are wielding a unique weapon, as the weapon can easily be lost when thrown from your hand.

also_attested_in.note: Zun Haal Viik, meaning Weapon Hand Defeat, is a shout that rips a weapon out of an opponent's hands.

shouts.name: Dismay

words.effect: Causes enemies up to level 7 within 36 feet to flee for 30 s
Causes enemies up to level 15 within 50 feet to flee for 30 s
Causes enemies up to level 24 within 93.75 feet to flee for 30 s

shouts.in_game_description: And the weak shall fear the Thu'um, and flee in terror.
shouts.wiki_summary: Dismay is a dragon shout that causes enemies to flee from you. It can hit any enemies in its radius, similar to Unrelenting Force.

also_attested_in.note: Faas Ru Maar, meaning Fear Run Terror, is a shout that forces enemies to flee in terror from the Tongue.

shouts.name: Dragon Aspect

words.effect: +25 Armor rating, and power attacks do 25% more damage
+100 Armor rating (total), Ancient Dragonborn summoned if health below 50%, +25% fire and frost resistance

shouts.in_game_description: Once a day, take on the mighty aspect of a dragon, delivering colossal blows, with an armored hide, and more powerful shouts.
shouts.wiki_summary: Dragon Aspect is a shout that improves your power attack damage, resistance to damage, and shout recharge time. When used, dragon-like traits will be physically applied to the one shouting in the form of a spectral armor.

also_attested_in.note: Mul Qah Diiv, meaning Strength Armor Wyrm, is a shout that gives the Tongue the strength to deliver colossal blows, magical armor to withstand powerful attacks, and an empowered thu'um. This shout can also summon an ancient Dragonborn to aid the Tongue in battle.

shouts.name: Dragonrend

words.location: Throat of the World (during Alduin's Bane)

shouts.in_game_description: Your Voice lashes out at a dragon's very soul, forcing the beast to land.
locations: Throat of the World (during Alduin's Bane)
shouts.wiki_summary: Dragonrend is a dragon shout that weakens a dragon and forces it to land. It is said to do so by forcing a dragon to experience mortality, a completely foreign concept to the ageless and immortal dragons.

also_attested_in.note: Joor Zah Frul, meaning Mortal Finite Temporary, is a shout that inflicts the concept of mortality upon a dragon, lashing at its very soul and forcing it to land. This shout was created by the Nords to slay these otherwise immortal beasts.

shouts.name: Drain Vitality

words.effect: Drains 5 points of Stamina per second for 30 seconds.
Drains 5 points of Stamina and Magicka per second for 30 seconds.
Drains 5 points each of Stamina, Magicka, and Health per second for 30 seconds.

shouts.in_game_description: Coax both magical and mortal energies from your hapless opponent.
shouts.wiki_summary: Drain Vitality is a dragon shout introduced in the Dawnguard add-on that drains stamina, magicka, and health from an enemy. The dragons added by Dawnguard, Revered and Legendary, each have their own version of this shout.

also_attested_in.note: Gaan Lah Haas, meaning Stamina Magicka Health, is a shout that drains magical and mortal energies from enemies.

shouts.name: Elemental Fury

words.location: Statue to Meridia (just uphill to the northeast)

shouts.in_game_description: The Thu'um imbues your arms with the speed of wind, allowing for faster weapon strikes.
locations: Statue to Meridia (just uphill to the northeast)
shouts.wiki_summary: Elemental Fury is a dragon shout that increases the speed of weapon swings and damage for a short time. It does not work on enchanted or bound weapons.

also_attested_in.note: Su Grah Dun, meaning Air Battle Grace, is a shout that allows the Tongue to fight faster and with more fury.

shouts.name: Fire Breath

words.location: Throat of the World (during The Throat of the World)

shouts.in_game_description: Inhale air, exhale flame, and behold the Thu'um as inferno.
locations: Throat of the World (during The Throat of the World)
shouts.wiki_summary: Fire Breath is a shout that deals fire damage to enemies, and potentially staggers them as well. Its use does not increase XP for the Destruction skill.

also_attested_in.note: Yol Toor Shul, meaning Fire Inferno Sun, allows the Tongue to exhale a torrent of flames.

shouts.in_game_description: Your breath is winter, you Thu'um a blizzard.
shouts.wiki_summary: Frost Breath is a dragon shout that deals frost damage to enemies.

also_attested_in.note: Fo Krah Diin, meaning Frost Cold Freeze, is a shout that allows the Tongue to breathe freezing cold winds.

shouts.name: Ice Form
shouts.in_game_description: Your Thu'um freezes an opponent solid.
shouts.wiki_summary: Ice Form is a dragon shout that encases foes in a solid block of ice which renders them completely immobile for the duration of the shout. Damage is dealt to the target over time.

also_attested_in.note: Iiz Slen Nus, meaning Ice Flesh Statue, is a shout that encases an opponent in ice, freezing them solid.

shouts.name: Ice Storm
shouts.availability: not on the wiki's list of shouts available to the player
shouts.wiki_summary: Ice Storm is an exclusive shout only used in combat by Sahrotaar during At the Summit of Apocrypha. It deals frost damage in an area.

shouts.name: Kyne's Peace

words.effect: Animals up to Level 20 within 75 feet are calmed for 60 s.
Animals up to Level 20 within 150 feet are calmed for 120 s.
Animals up to Level 20 within 225 feet are calmed for 180 s.

shouts.in_game_description: The Voice soothes wild beasts, who lose their desire to fight or flee.
shouts.wiki_summary: Kyne's Peace is a shout that calms animals. Affected creatures will not fight or flee.

also_attested_in.note: Kaan Drem Ov, meaning Kyne Peace Trust, is a shout that calms nearby animals into docility, making them unwilling to fight or flee.

shouts.name: Marked for Death

words.effect:
Damage Health 1 pt for 60 seconds
Damage Armor 25 pts for 60 seconds

Damage Health 2 pts for 60 seconds
Damage Armor 50 pts for 60 seconds

Damage Health 3 pts for 60 seconds
Damage Armor 75 pts for 60 seconds

shouts.in_game_description: Speak, and let your Voice herald doom, as an opponent's armor and lifeforce are weakened.
shouts.wiki_summary: Marked for Death is a shout that temporarily reduces an enemy's health and armor rating, making them more vulnerable to physical damage. Each word further decreases the target's armor rating by 25 points, which means they will take 3% extra physical damage per word.

also_attested_in.note: Krii Lun Aus, meaning Kill Leech Suffer, is a shout that weakens the armor and drains the life of an opponent, spelling their doom.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Online:Dragon, table of shouts spoken by generic dragons in ESO

shouts.name: Phantom Form
shouts.availability: not on the wiki's list of shouts available to the player
shouts.in_game_description: Phantom Form, for 8 secs
shouts.wiki_summary: Phantom Form is a dragon shout that creates a phantom. It is used by the Greybeards to create targets for shout practice.

also_attested_in.note: The shout used by the Greybeards to create ethereal forms for you to practice shouts on is called Phantom Form‎. Its words of power are "Fiik Lo Sah", which is translated as "Mirror Deceive Phantom". The shout was apparently intended to be available, as it is voiced for all races.
Fiik Lo Sah, meaning Mirror Deceive Phantom, is a shout that can create ethereal forms of the Tongue.

shouts.name: Slow Time

words.effect: Slows time to 30% of normal speed for 8 seconds.
Slows time to 20% of normal speed for 12 seconds.
Slows time to 10% of normal speed for 16 seconds.

shouts.in_game_description: Shout at time, and command it to obey, as the world around you stands still.
shouts.wiki_summary: Slow Time is a shout that slows down time. You are also affected, but not to the same extent.

also_attested_in.note: Tiid Klo Ul, meaning Time Sand Eternity, is a Shout that slows time around the Tongue.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Online:Dragon, table of shouts spoken by generic dragons in ESO

shouts.name: Soul Cairn Summon
shouts.availability: not on the wiki's list of shouts available to the player

words.effect: Calls 1 undead (Boneman) from Soul Cairn for 60 seconds.
Calls 2 undead (Boneman + Mistman) from Soul Cairn for 60 seconds.
Calls 3 undead (Boneman + Mistman + Wrathman) from Soul Cairn for 60 seconds.

shouts.in_game_description: Summon undead from the Soul Cairn.
shouts.wiki_summary: Soul Cairn Summon is a shout unique to Durnehviir, and therefore cannot be learned by the player aside from using console commands. It summons one Boneman, one Mistman, and one Wrathman with each consecutive word, summoning one of each with all three words.

also_attested_in.note: Dawnguard adds Soul Cairn Summon, a shout unique to Durnehviir. Its words of power are "Diil Qoth Zaam", translated as "Undead Tomb Slave". Each word summons an undead minion from the Soul Cairn; the full shout will summon a wrathman, boneman, and mistman to aid Durnehviir in combat. These summons are available to you, but rather in spell form. Even if you obtain this shout with console commands, you can only summon one undead unless you use the console to add the multiple summon perk that Durnehviir has.
Diil Qoth Zaam, meaning Undead Tomb Slave, is a shout that allows the Tongue to summon members of the Soul Guard from the Soul Cairn. It was used by Durnehviir.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Online:Dragon, table of shouts spoken by generic dragons in ESO

shouts.name: Soul Tear

words.location: Durnehviir teaches you a word each time you summon him from the Soul Cairn.

words.effect: Soul Trap for 2 secs on enemy, drain health 300 pts and reanimate body upon death for 1 minute.

shouts.in_game_description: Your Thu'um cuts through flesh and shatters soul, commanding the will of the fallen.
locations: Durnehviir teaches you a word each time you summon him from the Soul Cairn.
shouts.wiki_summary: Soul Tear is a dragon shout that is added with the Dawnguard add-on. At full strength, it casts soul trap upon foes, drains their health for 300 points on impact, and if the target is below level 100 and dies within 2 seconds, it captures their soul and resurrects the corpse to fight for you for 1 minute.

also_attested_in.note: Rii Vaaz Zol, meaning Essence Tear Zombie, is a shout that cuts through flesh and shatters soul, ripping the soul of an opponent out of them and raising them from the dead to fight for the Tongue.

also_attested_in.source_kind: Online:Dragon, table of shouts spoken by generic dragons in ESO

shouts.name: Storm Call

words.effect: Calls storm for 60 seconds. Each target within 100 feet is struck by a 40 damage lightning bolt every 3-6 seconds.
Calls storm for 120 seconds. Each target within 100 feet is struck by a 60 damage lightning bolt every 3-6 seconds.
Calls storm for 180 seconds. Each target within 150 feet is struck by an 80 damage lightning bolt every 3-6 seconds.

shouts.in_game_description: A Shout to the skies, a cry to the clouds, that awakens the destructive force of Skyrim's lightning.
shouts.wiki_summary: Storm Call is a shout that summons a storm of thunder and lightning. The lightning hits targets randomly and may hit friendly NPCs, who may be killed by the strikes, but will not hit you.

also_attested_in.note: Strun Bah Qo, meaning Storm Wrath Lightning, summons a storm and calls down lightning on the enemies of the Tongue.

shouts.name: Summon Durnehviir

words.location: Soul Cairn (all words learned together after Beyond Death)

shouts.in_game_description: Durnehviir! Hear my Voice and come forth from the Soul Cairn. I summon you in my time of need.
locations: Soul Cairn (all words learned together after Beyond Death)
shouts.wiki_summary: Summon Durnehviir is a dragon shout that summons Durnehviir, an undead dragon, from the Soul Cairn. Unlike the Call Dragon shout, the Summon Durnehviir shout works like a Conjuration spell.

shouts.name: Throw Voice
shouts.in_game_description: The Thu'um is heard, but its source unknown, fooling those into seeking it out.
shouts.wiki_summary: Throw Voice is a dragon shout that causes the shout to be heard from the point on a surface the player is targeting. Enemies will often go investigate the sound, allowing it to be used as a distraction.

also_attested_in.note: Zul Mey Gut, meaning Voice Fool Far, is a shout that allows the sound of the thu'um to appear from unknown sources, confounding enemies.

shouts.name: Unrelenting Force

words.location: Bleak Falls Sanctum (during The Golden Claw or Bleak Falls Barrow)
High Hrothgar (during The Way of the Voice)
High Hrothgar (during The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller)

shouts.in_game_description: Your Voice is raw power, pushing aside anything - or anyone - who stands in your path.
locations: Bleak Falls Sanctum (during The Golden Claw or Bleak Falls Barrow)
High Hrothgar (during The Way of the Voice)
High Hrothgar (during The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller)
shouts.wiki_summary: Unrelenting Force is a shout that pushes objects and entities. Weak versions of the shout stagger enemies and slightly push objects, while the strongest version will throw objects a great distance and turn enemies into a ragdoll, briefly rendering them helpless.

also_attested_in.note: Fus Ro Dah, meaning Force Balance Push, is a shout that pushes aside anything in the Tongue's path with an incredible wave of force.

shouts.name: Whirlwind Sprint

words.location: High Hrothgar (during The Way of the Voice)

shouts.in_game_description: The Thu'um rushes forward, carrying you in its wake with the speed of a tempest.
locations: High Hrothgar (during The Way of the Voice)
shouts.wiki_summary: Whirlwind Sprint is a shout that causes you to rush forward at great speed. It can be used even if you are overencumbered.

also_attested_in.note: Wuld Nah Kest, meaning Whirlwind Fury Tempest, is a shout that allows the Tongue to rush forward with immense speed.

shouts.name: Vile Vapor
shouts.availability: not available to the player (dragon or NPC only)
shouts.wiki_summary: Vile Vapor is an exclusive shout used in combat by the Afflicted during The Only Cure. Dawnguard adds the Reaper, who also has this ability.
shouts.source_kind: Skyrim shout page without a {{Shout Summary}} infobox
shouts.notes: the wiki gives no words of power for this shout

shouts.name: Dragon Storm Call
shouts.availability: not available to the player (dragon or NPC only)
shouts.wiki_summary: Alduin has a dragon shout named "Dragon Storm Call". It is similar to Storm Call, but it calls forth a meteor storm instead of a lightning storm and the sky turns red instead of stormy gray. Alduin used this shout to destroy Helgen. Clear Skies interrupts the storm.
shouts.notes: the wiki gives no words of power for this shout

shouts.name: ResurrectionShout
shouts.availability: not available to the player (dragon or NPC only)
shouts.wiki_summary: Alduin has another shout called "ResurrectionShout" that resurrects dead dragons. Its words of power are "Slen Tiid Vo", which translate to "Flesh Time (Opposite of)". It should be noted that you can learn the words Tiid (Time) and Slen (Flesh), showing that words can be part of different shouts.

also_attested_in.note: Slen Tiid Vo, meaning Flesh Time (Opposite of), is a shout used by Alduin to resurrect long-dead dragons.

shouts.name: Soul-snare mist (Alduin, Sovngarde)
shouts.availability: not available to the player (dragon or NPC only)
shouts.wiki_summary: The soul-snare mist created by Alduin in Sovngarde is technically not a dragon shout, but a script. It creates a mist where Alduin hides and feeds upon the trapped souls. Its words of power are "Ven Mul Riik", which translate to "Wind Strong Gale".

also_attested_in.note: Ven Mul Riik, meaning Wind Strong Gale, is a shout used by Alduin to ensnare the souls of Sovngarde in a mist. This is a shout that Alduin guards jealously.

shouts.name: Tsun's shout returning the player to Nirn
shouts.availability: not available to the player (dragon or NPC only)
shouts.wiki_summary: The shout used by Tsun to return you to Nirn from Sovngarde is another unavailable shout. Its words of power are "Nahl Daal Vus", which translate to "Living Return Nirn".

also_attested_in.note: This is a shout used by Tsun to return the Last Dragonborn to Nirn after Alduin is defeated.

shouts.name: Open (Borri's gate word; the wiki says it is a script, not a shout)
shouts.availability: not a shout according to the wiki (a script)
shouts.wiki_summary: During the learning of Whirlwind Sprint, Borri opens the gate doors by saying "Bex", meaning "Open". This is not a shout, but a script.

shouts.name: Steam Breath
shouts.availability: not available to the player (dragon or NPC only)
shouts.wiki_summary: Dwarven Centurions have a "Steam Breath" power that is treated as a dragon shout by the game engine. The closest thing you can obtain to this is the lesser power Breath of Nchuak, added by Dragonborn and only available with the Visage of Mzund equipped.
shouts.notes: the wiki gives no words of power for this shout

lore_thuum_list.name: Animal Allegiance
lore_thuum_list.description: Raan Mir Tah, meaning Animal Allegiance Pack, is a shout that can call for the beasts of the wilderness to aid the Tongue in combat.

lore_thuum_list.name: Aura Whisper
lore_thuum_list.description: Laas Yah Nir, meaning Life Seek Hunt, is a shout that reveals the life force of any and all beings nearby.

lore_thuum_list.name: Battle Fury
lore_thuum_list.description: Mid Vur Shaan, meaning Loyal Valor Inspire, is a shout that allows the allies of the Tongue to fight faster and with more fury.

lore_thuum_list.name: Become Ethereal
lore_thuum_list.description: Feim Zii Gron, meaning Fade Spirit Bind, is a shout that turns the Tongue into an intangible ghost-like form, unable to be harmed.

lore_thuum_list.name: Bend Will
lore_thuum_list.description: Gol Hah Dov, meaning Earth Mind Dragon, allows the Tongue to bend and control the will of others, even dragons.

lore_thuum_list.name: Blade Sharpening
lore_thuum_list.description: It is said that shouts can be used to sharpen blades.

lore_thuum_list.name: Blizzard
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that formed a blizzard around them, similar to the Destruction spell of the same name.

lore_thuum_list.name: Bravery
lore_thuum_list.description: It is said that a strong Nord can instill bravery in men with his battle-cry.

lore_thuum_list.name: Call Dragon
lore_thuum_list.description: The name of a dragon is a shout, and calling them will summon them. The dragon is not compelled to answer the call.

lore_thuum_list.name: Call of Valor
lore_thuum_list.description: Hun Kaal Zoor, meaning Hero Champion Legend, is a shout that can summon the ghost of a hero from Sovngarde to aid the Tongue in battle.

lore_thuum_list.name: Call Person
lore_thuum_list.description: It is said that the greatest of the Nords can call to specific people over hundreds of miles.

lore_thuum_list.name: Clear Skies
lore_thuum_list.description: Lok Vah Koor, meaning Sky Spring Summer, is a shout that can dispel storms and clouds, and even magical mists.

lore_thuum_list.name: Command
lore_thuum_list.description: It is said that the power of command is a common effect of shouting.

lore_thuum_list.name: Cyclone
lore_thuum_list.description: Ven Gaar Nos, meaning Wind Unleash Strike, is a shout that can summon a whirling tornado.

lore_thuum_list.name: Disarm
lore_thuum_list.description: Zun Haal Viik, meaning Weapon Hand Defeat, is a shout that rips a weapon out of an opponent's hands.

lore_thuum_list.name: Dismay
lore_thuum_list.description: Faas Ru Maar, meaning Fear Run Terror, is a shout that forces enemies to flee in terror from the Tongue.

lore_thuum_list.name: Dragon Aspect
lore_thuum_list.description: Mul Qah Diiv, meaning Strength Armor Wyrm, is a shout that gives the Tongue the strength to deliver colossal blows, magical armor to withstand powerful attacks, and an empowered thu'um. This shout can also summon an ancient Dragonborn to aid the Tongue in battle.

lore_thuum_list.name: Dragonrend
lore_thuum_list.description: Joor Zah Frul, meaning Mortal Finite Temporary, is a shout that inflicts the concept of mortality upon a dragon, lashing at its very soul and forcing it to land. This shout was created by the Nords to slay these otherwise immortal beasts.

lore_thuum_list.name: Dragon Storm Call
lore_thuum_list.description: This is a shout commonly used by Alduin the World-Eater, though other dragons have been shown to know it. The shout turns the sky red and rains down flaming boulders from the sky in a meteor storm.

lore_thuum_list.name: Drain Vitality
lore_thuum_list.description: Gaan Lah Haas, meaning Stamina Magicka Health, is a shout that drains magical and mortal energies from enemies.

lore_thuum_list.name: Earth Spike
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that casts balls of fire to the ground, summoning molten stalagmites to emerge where they land. These spikes could then explode in fire and lava when an enemy walked nearby.

lore_thuum_list.name: Elemental Fury
lore_thuum_list.description: Su Grah Dun, meaning Air Battle Grace, is a shout that allows the Tongue to fight faster and with more fury.

lore_thuum_list.name: Event Denouement
lore_thuum_list.description: Event Denouement is a shout used by Barfok, Maid of Planes, to guarantee her victory in any battle she fought.

lore_thuum_list.name: Fireball
lore_thuum_list.description: Many dragons have used a shout that casts a fireball towards their enemy, similar to the Destruction spell of the same name.

lore_thuum_list.name: Fire Breath
lore_thuum_list.description: Yol Toor Shul, meaning Fire Inferno Sun, allows the Tongue to exhale a torrent of flames.

lore_thuum_list.name: Form Change
lore_thuum_list.description: This shout could be used by Bhag, the Two-Tongued, though it is unknown if this refers to an ability to shapeshift or his ability to speak in two layers.

lore_thuum_list.name: Frostbolt
lore_thuum_list.description: Some Second Era dragons used a shout that launched a ball of ice toward their enemies.

lore_thuum_list.name: Frost Breath
lore_thuum_list.description: Fo Krah Diin, meaning Frost Cold Freeze, is a shout that allows the Tongue to breathe freezing cold winds.

lore_thuum_list.name: Heart Roaring
lore_thuum_list.description: This is a shout used by Chemua, the Running Hunger, to turn an opponent against their own allies.

lore_thuum_list.name: Ice Fields
lore_thuum_list.description: Some Second Era dragons used a shout that raised sharp icicles from the ground.

lore_thuum_list.name: Ice Form
lore_thuum_list.description: Iiz Slen Nus, meaning Ice Flesh Statue, is a shout that encases an opponent in ice, freezing them solid.

lore_thuum_list.name: Ice Storm
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Fourth Era used a shout that casts a swirling storm of ice, similar to the Destruction spell of the same name.

lore_thuum_list.name: Kyne's Peace
lore_thuum_list.description: Kaan Drem Ov, meaning Kyne Peace Trust, is a shout that calms nearby animals into docility, making them unwilling to fight or flee.

lore_thuum_list.name: Lightning Bolt
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that casts a lightning bolt towards their enemy, similar to the Destruction spell of the same name.

lore_thuum_list.name: Lightning Breath
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era could exhale arcs of lightning towards their enemies.

lore_thuum_list.name: Marked for Death
lore_thuum_list.description: Krii Lun Aus, meaning Kill Leech Suffer, is a shout that weakens the armor and drains the life of an opponent, spelling their doom.

lore_thuum_list.name: Nahl Daal Vus
lore_thuum_list.description: This is a shout used by Tsun to return the Last Dragonborn to Nirn after Alduin is defeated.

lore_thuum_list.name: Open
lore_thuum_list.description: Bex, meaning "Open", can open doors.

lore_thuum_list.name: Phantom Form
lore_thuum_list.description: Fiik Lo Sah, meaning Mirror Deceive Phantom, is a shout that can create ethereal forms of the Tongue.

lore_thuum_list.name: Raise Dead
lore_thuum_list.description: Used by Hoaga, Mouth of Mud, and some dragons, this shout can raise the dead to fight again.

lore_thuum_list.name: Resurrection Shout
lore_thuum_list.description: Slen Tiid Vo, meaning Flesh Time (Opposite of), is a shout used by Alduin to resurrect long-dead dragons.

lore_thuum_list.name: Shor's Song
lore_thuum_list.description: The Greybeards were able to sing Shor's ghost into the world, allowing the dead god to lead the armies of the Nords in the Battle of Red Mountain.

lore_thuum_list.name: Sky Sickening
lore_thuum_list.description: Chemua, the Running Hunger, could use this shout to "give clouds stomach aches", turning the rain into bile.

lore_thuum_list.name: Slow Time
lore_thuum_list.description: Tiid Klo Ul, meaning Time Sand Eternity, is a Shout that slows time around the Tongue.

lore_thuum_list.name: Soul Cairn Summon
lore_thuum_list.description: Diil Qoth Zaam, meaning Undead Tomb Slave, is a shout that allows the Tongue to summon members of the Soul Guard from the Soul Cairn. It was used by Durnehviir.

lore_thuum_list.name: Soul-Snare Mist
lore_thuum_list.description: Ven Mul Riik, meaning Wind Strong Gale, is a shout used by Alduin to ensnare the souls of Sovngarde in a mist. This is a shout that Alduin guards jealously.

lore_thuum_list.name: Soul Tear
lore_thuum_list.description: Rii Vaaz Zol, meaning Essence Tear Zombie, is a shout that cuts through flesh and shatters soul, ripping the soul of an opponent out of them and raising them from the dead to fight for the Tongue.

lore_thuum_list.name: Storm Call
lore_thuum_list.description: Strun Bah Qo, meaning Storm Wrath Lightning, summons a storm and calls down lightning on the enemies of the Tongue.

lore_thuum_list.name: Strike Enemy
lore_thuum_list.description: Shouts can be used to strike enemies.

lore_thuum_list.name: Summon Durnehviir
lore_thuum_list.description: Similar to Call Dragon, except this shout allowed the Last Dragonborn to summon Durnehviir from the Soul Cairn.

lore_thuum_list.name: Summon Fire Atronachs
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that could summon fire atronachs.

lore_thuum_list.name: Summon Flame Wyrms
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that could summon flame wyrms.

lore_thuum_list.name: Summon Frost Atronachs
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that could summon frost atronachs.

lore_thuum_list.name: Summon Iron Atronachs
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that could summon iron atronachs.

lore_thuum_list.name: Summon Storm Atronachs
lore_thuum_list.description: Some dragons in the Second Era used a shout that could summon storm atronachs.

lore_thuum_list.name: Surety
lore_thuum_list.description: This shout could be used by Bhag, the Two-Tongued, though its effects are unknown.

lore_thuum_list.name: Teleportation Shout
lore_thuum_list.description: It is said that the greatest Nords can move by casting a shout, appearing where it lands.

lore_thuum_list.name: Throw Voice
lore_thuum_list.description: Zul Mey Gut, meaning Voice Fool Far, is a shout that allows the sound of the thu'um to appear from unknown sources, confounding enemies.

lore_thuum_list.name: Unrelenting Force
lore_thuum_list.description: Fus Ro Dah, meaning Force Balance Push, is a shout that pushes aside anything in the Tongue's path with an incredible wave of force.

lore_thuum_list.name: What Happens When You Shake the Dragon Just So
lore_thuum_list.description: This shout was used by Ysmir Wulfharth to restore the Nords to their proper ages after "nearly every Nord was eaten down to six years old" by Alduin.

lore_thuum_list.name: Whirlwind Sprint
lore_thuum_list.description: Wuld Nah Kest, meaning Whirlwind Fury Tempest, is a shout that allows the Tongue to rush forward with immense speed.
